Name: Banties and Quail for Adopt 'n' Skin
Author: Hollowstyx
Description:
Much like bantams in real life, these little chickens are pint sized versions of the Stardew Valley chickens you know and love. I made some quail and a handful of silly sprites, too, so you have your pick of tiny birds!

The sprites include:
18 Chickens
2 "Blue" Chickens
2 Void Chickens
9 Quail
1 Dove
2 Tiny penguins

The skins are labeled for use with Adopt 'n' Skin, and there's an index of which skin is which color included. Feel free to mix them around or only use what you want! This is NOT a stand alone mod and it will NOT work without Adopt 'n' Skin.
To Install just drop the folders into the "skins" folder for Adopt 'n' Skin! The path should be something like Stardew Valley\Mods\AdoptSkin\assets\skins, depending on where all your stuff is installed.
